title: Grilled Cheese, Smoked Bacon & Tomato Soup Dumplings
ingredients:
Shredded white cheddar
Velveeta, finely chopped
Shredded Fontina
Shredded provolone
Goat cheese, softened
Cream cheese, softened
Roma tomato, very finely minced
Fresh basil, finely chopped
Fresh chives, finely chopped
Wonton/dumpling wrappers
1 egg, beaten
Creamy tomato soup
2 strips smoked bacon, cooked very crispy and chopped
Chives
Vegitable Oil
instructions:
Cook the bacon until crispy. Chop into tiny pieces and set aside.
Make the filling: Mix all 6 cheeses together. Add a little finely chopped tomato, basil, and chives.
Beat 1 egg in a small bowl.
Make the dumpling: Take ONE wonton wrapper. Put about 1 teaspoon of cheese mixture in the center. Brush egg around the edges.
Make a pouch: Pull the wrapper up around the cheese and pinch it together. Leave the very top slightly open.
Heat the oil: Put about ½ inch of vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat.
Fry: Stand the dumpling upright in the oil. Fry until golden and crispy, about 1–2 minutes total. Do one test dumpling first.
Heat the tomato soup separately.
Serve: Put tomato soup in a Chinese soup spoon → put the dumpling in the soup → sprinkle crispy bacon + chives on top.
